summary: dellemc.openmanage known issues for 11.9.0: idrac_attributes accepts both string and integer for SNMP.1.AgentCommunity on iDRAC10, idrac_diagnostics can't export via SOCKS proxy, and ome_smart_fabric_uplink modifies same-named uplinks.
questions: Should SNMP.1.AgentCommunity be a string or integer on iDRAC10?
Which openmanage issues are known in Ansible 11.9.0?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (11.9.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `idrac_attributes`: accepts both string and integer for `SNMP.1.AgentCommunity` on iDRAC10.
- `idrac_diagnostics`: no export via SOCKS proxy to HTTP/HTTPS shares.
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: a duplicate name modifies the existing uplink.
